# Tidal Turbine

A rotor driven by tidal flow. Invented fixture content; this vault holds no real subject.

## Open questions

- What is the measured capacity factor of a rack-mounted tidal turbine over a full spring-neap cycle?
- No source in this pass gives an installed-cost figure per megawatt for a rack-mounted array.
- Tidal turbine blade fatigue under continuous sediment loading was not measured by either source in this pass.
- The maintenance interval claimed for sealed nacelle bearings is reported by the manufacturer alone and nothing
  independent confirms it, which is the kind of figure a dedicated engineering pass would have to establish before
  any of the lifetime economics above can be taken as settled rather than as a vendor claim.
- Which coating materials reduce sediment abrasion on tidal turbine blades?
